30374.title: Window anchors: movement uses the event date, billed uses the WO date

custom_expected.intended:
1. In W1 (work-order date in window): the billed columns (Revenue, Margin, Avg Cost, Avg Sell, Margin %, Sold (WO), Sold (Parts Sale)) count the sale, while inventory Units Sold / Demand do NOT (their movement event is outside W1).
